summary.text: Tucker Smith is the Democratic candidate for the Utah State Senate, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Keith Grover.

A teacher who earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2018, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports universal childcare, universal pre-K and tuition-free public K-12 education.

paragraphs.text: Smith earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2018, and his Ballotpedia profile lists his career experience as working as a teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he supports universal childcare, universal pre-K and fully funded, tuition-free public K-12 education that eliminates school fees.
He also said he supports protecting labor unions and strengthening worker protections, and that he favors zoning reform and requiring affordable units in new developments to address housing costs.
Smith named universal access to public education, campaign finance reform and equal housing policies as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
